patch_description: This uses a different surrogate from path-reward models: it rewards direct traffic links, then adds sparse positive couplings between links that share a source or destination when their traffic profiles are redundant. Those couplings favor networks whose two gateways at a node offer complementary service, rather than repeatedly rewarding every possible two-hop path. The interactions are limited to shared-endpoint pairs, keeping the QUBO sparse and encouraging useful local communities.
